subject: App crashes when exporting report
body: Every time I click 'Export to PDF' on the monthly sales report the application closes. Started after yesterday's update.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: I see two payments of 49 EUR on my bank statement for the October subscription. Please refund one of them.

subject: Cannot log in
body: I reset my password three times but the login page still says 'invalid credentials'. I have a client demo in one hour.

subject: Dark mode please
body: Would be great to have a dark mode for the dashboard, our team works late and the white screen is tiring.

subject: Whole platform down
body: None of our 40 restaurants can access the ordering system. Error 503 everywhere. We are losing sales right now!

subject: Question about your office hours
body: Hello, what are your support opening hours during the Christmas holidays?

subject: Facture incorrecte
body: Bonjour, notre facture de septembre indique 25 licences alors que nous n'en avons que 20. Merci de corriger.

subject: 2FA code never arrives
body: I enabled two-factor authentication but the SMS code never arrives, so I am locked out of my account.

subject: API returns wrong timezone
body: The /orders endpoint returns timestamps in UTC+2 while the docs say UTC. Our reports are shifted by two hours.

subject: Export users to CSV
body: Could you add a button to export the list of users and their roles to CSV? We need it for our yearly audit.

subject: Need VAT number on invoices
body: Our accounting department requires our intra-community VAT number to appear on all invoices. Can you update our billing profile?

subject: Mot de passe oublié, lien expiré
body: Le lien de réinitialisation du mot de passe expire avant même que je puisse cliquer dessus. Je ne peux plus accéder à mon compte.

subject: Images not loading
body: Product images on the catalogue page show a broken icon since this morning, on Chrome and Firefox.

subject: Partnership proposal
body: We are a bakery chain interested in a partnership with your company. Who should we talk to?

subject: Payment failed but account suspended
body: My card payment failed because of my bank, and now my whole team account is suspended. We cannot work at all.

subject: Add SSO with Google
body: Our school would like teachers to log in with their Google Workspace accounts instead of separate passwords.

subject: Data not saving
body: When I edit a patient appointment and click Save, nothing happens and the changes are lost. This is affecting our clinic today.

subject: New employee needs access
body: We hired a new project manager. How do I create an account for her with the same permissions as mine?

subject: Switch to annual plan
body: We would like to move from monthly to annual billing to get the discount. What is the process?

subject: Notifications envoyées en double
body: Nos clients reçoivent chaque e-mail de confirmation deux fois depuis lundi. Ça commence à générer des plaintes.

subject: Webhooks for status changes
body: It would help us a lot if you could send a webhook when an order status changes, so we can sync with our ERP.

subject: Suspicious login from abroad
body: One of our admins received an alert about a login from another country at 3am. He was asleep. Please lock the account immediately.

subject: Refund request
body: I cancelled my subscription on the 2nd but was still charged on the 5th. I would like a refund please.

subject: Search returns no results
body: Searching for any product name in the admin panel returns 'no results', even for products that exist.

subject: Job opportunities?
body: Hi, I am a developer and I love your product. Are you hiring interns for 2027?

subject: Account locked after failed attempts
body: I typed my password wrong a few times and now my account is locked. How long until I can try again?

subject: Bulk import from Excel
body: Please add a way to import products in bulk from an Excel file. Adding 2,000 products one by one is not realistic.

subject: Changement de carte bancaire
body: Notre carte d'entreprise expire à la fin du mois. Comment mettre à jour le moyen de paiement ?

subject: Mobile app freezes on Android 15
body: The app freezes on the splash screen on all our Android 15 test phones. iOS works fine.

subject: GDPR data request
body: A former client asks us to provide all data you store about him under GDPR. How can we export it?

subject: Booking payments not going through
body: Guests cannot pay for bookings on our website: the payment step spins forever. It's peak season and we are losing bookings every minute.

subject: Remove a former employee
body: An employee left the company last week. Please make sure he no longer has access to our account.

subject: Custom branding on emails
body: Can we use our own logo and colours in the emails your platform sends to our customers?

subject: Price increase explanation
body: Our invoice went from 300 to 420 EUR this month without notice. Can you explain the change?

subject: Le tableau de bord ne charge plus
body: Depuis ce matin le tableau de bord reste blanc après la connexion. Toute l'équipe pédagogique est bloquée.

subject: Thanks!
body: Just wanted to say your support team solved our issue really fast last week. Great job!

subject: Change account owner email
body: The account owner left the company. We need to transfer ownership to my email address.

subject: API rate limit too low
body: Our integration hits the 100 requests/minute limit during peaks. Could you offer a higher limit on the business plan?

subject: Need invoices for 2025
body: Our accountant needs all invoices from 2025 for the annual closing. Where can I download them?

subject: Wrong totals in CSV export
body: The totals in the CSV export don't match the totals displayed on screen. Rounding problem?

subject: Accès refusé après changement de rôle
body: Depuis qu'on m'a donné le rôle de manager, j'ai une erreur 'accès refusé' sur la page des rapports.

subject: Multi-currency support
body: We operate in Nigeria and Ghana. Supporting NGN and GHS currencies would let us roll out to all branches.

subject: Customers charged but no order created
body: Several customers were charged on their card but no order appears in our system. We have 15 angry customers already.

subject: Invoice in CHF
body: We are based in Switzerland. Is it possible to be invoiced in CHF instead of EUR?

subject: Interview request
body: I'm a journalist writing about French SaaS companies. Could I interview someone from your team next week?

subject: Session expires too fast
body: We are logged out every 5 minutes, even while typing. Nurses lose their notes. Please fix urgently.

subject: Ajouter un calendrier partagé
body: Ce serait pratique d'avoir un calendrier partagé entre les agents pour planifier les visites.

subject: All users locked out after SSO change
body: After our IT team changed the SSO certificate, none of our 300 employees can log in. Urgent!

subject: Discount code not applied
body: We used the code WELCOME20 at checkout but the invoice shows the full price.

subject: Hello
body: Hello, I clicked on a link and arrived here. What does your company do exactly?
